create_dpr_retriever: create a DPR retriever instance with a name and configuration for dense passage retrieval
set_queries_data_dpr: set queries data on a DPR retriever with a list of query objects containing query and id fields
run_dpr_retrieval: run DPR retrieval to get top-n document passages for each query with scores and wikipedia metadata
build_dpr_with_hnsw_index: build a DPR retriever using a precomputed HNSW Faiss index for approximate nearest neighbor search
build_dpr_with_flat_index: build a DPR retriever that encodes and indexes passage vectors with DenseFlatIndexer for exact nearest neighbor search
